title: Basic Class
prompt:
Write a `BankAccount` class in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `__init__(self, owner, balance=0)` -- store the owner name and starting balance
2. `deposit(self, amount)` -- adds the amount to the balance
3. `withdraw(self, amount)` -- subtracts the amount from the balance; raises `ValueError` if insufficient funds
4. `get_balance(self)` -- returns the current balance

**Examples:**
```python
account = BankAccount("Alice", 100)
account.deposit(50)
account.get_balance()   # 150
account.withdraw(30)    # OK
account.withdraw(200)   # raises ValueError
```
hints: self is the first parameter of every instance method
__init__ is the constructor -- called when creating an instance
self.balance stores data on the instance
raise ValueError('message') signals an error condition

solution.py.name: __init__
solution.py.description: Define __init__ with owner and balance parameters

solution.py.name: deposit
solution.py.description: Define a deposit method that accepts an amount

solution.py.name: withdraw
solution.py.description: Define a withdraw method that accepts an amount
Raise ValueError in withdraw for insufficient funds
solution.py.hint: Use raise ValueError('Insufficient funds') when amount exceeds balance
